d:
U.S. President Donald Trump is facing mounting pressure ahead of the U.S. midterm elections. With Democrats gaining ground in the polls, rising living costs fuelling voter anger, and Republicans distancing themselves from the President, the battle for Congress is getting tougher.
Trump is also facing questions over his campaign strategy as tensions grow within his own team. Can Republicans hold on to Congress, or will the midterms weaken Trump’s grip on power?
